project: McDonald's Store 042-3513, Godley, TX (JAW 24-0154, 2024 Standard Building BB20, Revision 3 dated 07/27/26). EIFS bands at the Front and Non-Drive-Thru elevations per sheet A2.0.
scope_summary: EIFS in Iron Ore SW 7069 at the two 29 ft canopy bands between the aluminum batten towers, from the top of canopy to the 18'-3" fascia line, including control joints and terminations; work above 12 ft and mobilization included.

lines.source: sheet A2.0, 1/A2.0 Front Elevation, tag E
sheet A2.0, 2/A2.0 Non-Drive-Thru Elevation, tag E

lines.detail: Four vertical joints, two per band.
Top at metal fascia, bottom at canopy, and ends at battens, both bands.
Total EIFS scope is 392 sq ft.
Scaffold or lift at two facades, 29 ft each, delivery, two setups and pickup.

exclusions_extra: The drive-thru and rear elevations carry no EIFS. The EIFS wall section details 6/A5.3 and 7/A5.3 were not in the drawings provided; insulation thickness and the manufacturer's system are to be confirmed from those sheets.
